title: Urban Sports Club vs Gym in Berlin - Quick Summary
kicker: WALK OF BERLIN • LIVING IN BERLIN
items: **Urban Sports Club in Berlin costs €45, €75, €115 or €165 a month** for Essential, Classic, Premium and Max on a monthly term, €39 to €154 on 12 months (prices checked 1 October 2026).
**Essential gives 8 check-ins a month in total;** the other plans give one check-in a day, and Premium and Max add 4 or 8 Plus check-ins for wellness.
**Every venue sets its own limit per plan: daily, 8 or 4 times a month, or not at all.** EVO Fitness Rosenthaler Platz allows only 4 visits a month on Classic.
**One sport, one place, three or four times a week: a normal membership wins.** FitX costs €29 a month plus a €29 joining fee, McFit €29.90 plus fees, EVO €54.90 on 12 months.
**A mixed week is where the flat rate pays:** two bouldering sessions, one swim and one HYROX class a week cost at least €177 a month paid directly, or €75 on Classic.
**Swimmers should check the Berliner Bäder first:** €6 for 90 minutes in a Kategorie 1 pool, or the Flex subscription at €38 a month for unlimited swimming in every pool.
**Before you sign:** look up your two favourite venues' limits on Classic, ask your employer about a corporate membership, and plan for the visits you really did last month.
